scenario.name: VLC libvlc sideloading, export-forwarding proxying, path-filter falsification, persistence, and Sliver self-injection
scenario.placement_reason: The repository index generator indexes brought-in tools under tools and reference sites under lol/sites. This work verifies a technique with a lab-authored DLL and no brought-in sideload generator, so it belongs under lol/techniques rather than either indexed collection.

audit.scenario_coverage: 10/12 grounded lab-runnable use-cases (83%, above 60% floor after adding C1 and D1)
audit.prior_gate_error: Iteration 1 exit 2: auditor cannot run as root; never treated as a pass

pass_pinning_correction.why_wrong: Iteration 2 measured the feature commit before the audit-response commit. The gate that actually passed the exact merged PR #42 tree was iteration 3 on 3f2fe975fe4257c64c3a476b35641308fa7c9994; a PASS is pinned to one tree and cannot be silently carried to another.

orchestrator.role: AI VM / VM 102 provisioning and orchestration only

instrumentation.proof: Every accepted image-load run dumped the active configuration and captured a positive benign notepad.exe EID 7 before scenario start.
instrumentation.fp_denominator_policy: Run volumes are informational only; precision uses audit/catalog/baseline-category-metrics.json.

proxy_build.description: objdump the official libvlc export table; generate a .def with all 316 names and original ordinals forwarding to libvlc_org.<name>; compile a DLL whose DllMain starts a separate payload thread; retain the signed original as libvlc_org.dll

hypotheses.H1: proved: upstream libvlc rule fired on user-writable M1, M2, and M3
hypotheses.H2: partially refuted: most alternate spellings were detected, but a successful Administrator-only plant under the exact default prefix, including case variation, was filtered
hypotheses.H3: proved: upstream and local image-load rules fired after vlc.exe was renamed updater.exe; the other upstream process rules missed all three forms
hypotheses.H4: refuted as a detection dependency: plain sideload stalled while proxy forms exited 0, but signal sets still fired on both
hypotheses.H5: refuted for VLC 3.0.21: libvlc_org.dll reported OriginalFileName '-' despite valid VideoLAN signature; no proxy-identity rule authored
hypotheses.H6: proved gap and relaxed the name-independent hunt; 516/727396 FP, three of four named recall samples, and retained prior-run M1/M2/M3 hits plus C0 silence
hypotheses.H7: self-injection and host attribution proved; full usable Sliver C2 session not established; existing Sliver JA3/JA3S rules cover the completed-TLS diagnostic and no duplicate rule was authored
hypotheses.H8: proved: HKLM Run value and SYSTEM scheduled task pointed to the renamed proxy host; scheduled launch exited 0 and wrote the marker
hypotheses.H9: executed: VS Code produced 0 merged/relaxed matches; Evernote produced 7 under both forms across five unsigned application DLL names; no attacker-controlled exclusion added
hypotheses.H10: executed: D1 produced one same-writer/same-directory ten-second EXE+DLL cluster, but the baseline measured 278/542441 and Evernote produced three benign clusters, so no file-event rule was shipped
hypotheses.H11: partially useful: the D1 ZIP carried ZoneId=3 and EID 15 recorded it, but MOTW did not propagate to the extracted host or DLLs and therefore did not discriminate the eventual sideload

precision.repo_commit_measured: working tree derived from 5d6756509223fa99828bd45f3ff749e495df553d; final gate commit recorded separately
precision.auditor_adjustment: high because portable applications and per-user updaters commonly load their own unsigned DLLs; relaxing the process path added only 11 baseline matches while recovering Program Files hosts that load a user-writable DLL

sigma.limitations: EID 7 signature fields describe only the loaded DLL; Sigma cannot prove host signature or compare Image and ImageLoaded directories.
